name: jev-router
description: Per-turn model routing: TypeSafe Jev picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for each prompt (port of gargpratyush/jev-router).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Jev API key. Falls back to JEV_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_API_KEY or TYPESAVEAI_KEY in the environment, then ~/.jev-router.env.

allowFable.title: Allow Fable
allowFable.description: Let Jev route to the long tier (Fable bills extra usage credits).

routeOnStart.title: Route from session start
routeOnStart.description: Start each session with routing on. Off: run /jev on to start.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: SystemOne URL. Empty: TypeSafe (https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone). Self-hosted clef-flash: http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/systemone (no API key needed).
